metric_protocol.matching: maximum one-to-one original exclusive RGB bbox IoU>=0.50; exact Unicode casefold, punctuation retained
metric_protocol.ignore: only wholly invalid first-pass instances excluded after inference; same identities across arms; all 983 evaluation care words retained
metric_protocol.localization: one anchored output per original proposal; empty component or absent predicted kernel explicitly retains baseline bbox; no new orphan words; no area filter, no padding, no cap
metric_protocol.selection: 100 disjoint head-calibration TRAIN images; maximize exact read+localized words, then OCR Hmean, geometry Hmean; off baseline wins ties; fixed epochs 0/5/10/20; no evaluation-based selection
metric_protocol.scope: repeatedly reused official TRAIN holdout; calibration previously seen by original segmentation; exploratory approximate reproduction

scientific_choices.rationale: Paper sections 3.2-3.3 specify segmentation followed by component crops; none of these extra training procedures is paper reproduction.
Reuse the completed hash-bound word-evidence suite, its frozen v1 control Text/Kernel maps and v4 care-owner ordering; no source checkpoint is retrained.

Fresh three-layer 24-channel RGB/Text/prompt CNN, selected-word binary target from majority predicted kernel owner, valid neighboring words negative; identical no-prompt control; private local decoder learns, source U-Net fixed.

Same fresh four-edge local affinity CNN and class-balanced edge BCE in both arms; add local maximin BCE at weight .25, at most16 deterministic equal-total-weight anchors per care word, maximum spanning forest over valid local canvas. Not original MALIS all-pairs squared Rand loss. Background can carry paths but not pair endpoint labels.

Same RGB/Text/prompt geometry CNN and bounded four-side deltas in both arms; normalized SmoothL1 against qualified native owner bbox, plus .1 frozen official PARSeq causal teacher-forcing CE with exact supported transcript and EOS. Empty/unsupported/long OCR training labels counted without excluding evaluation GT.
